CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database


Private Sub Form_Close()
Dim db As Database, rng As Recordset
Set db = DBEngine.Workspaces(0).Databases(0)
wtable = Forms("Редактирование_отчетных_данных")!var
sqlng = "select ved from [" & wtable & "] where ved=99;"
Set rng = db.OpenRecordset(sqlng)
If Not rng.EOF Then bm = MsgBox("Станция не разбита на группы оборудования", vbOKOnly)
rng.Close
End Sub


Private Sub OK_Click()
Dim db As Database, rcheck As Recordset, rcl As Recordset, codeob As Variant
i = liststan.ListIndex
NUMB1120 = liststan.Column(1, i)
wtable = Forms("Редактирование_отчетных_данных").Form!var
sqlcheck = "select numb1120 from [" & wtable & "] where numb1120=" & NUMB1120 & ";"
Set db = DBEngine.Workspaces(0).Databases(0)
Set rcheck = db.OpenRecordset(sqlcheck)
If Not rcheck.EOF Then
bm = MsgBox("Станция уже присутствует в данном варианте", vbOKOnly)
GoTo endp
End If
rcheck.Close
sqlcl = "select name,numb,main,comp,тип,ведомство,ordnumb,oes,dep,er,obl from имена_станций where numb=" & NUMB1120 & ";"
Set rcl = db.OpenRecordset(sqlcl)
rcl.MoveFirst
If z(rcl!MAIN) > 0 Then
sqlcheck = Replace(sqlcheck, "numb1120=" & NUMB1120, "numb1120=" & rcl!MAIN)
Set rcheck = db.OpenRecordset(sqlcheck)
If rcheck.EOF Then
bm = MsgBox("Группа оборудования не может быть вставлена раньше станции", vbOKOnly)
GoTo endp
End If
rcheck.Close
End If
If rcl!COMP = 1 Then splitcomp = MsgBox("Будет ли станция разбита на группы оборудования?", vbYesNo)
If rcl!COMP = 1 And splitcomp = vbYes Then
v = 99
Else
If rcl!тип < 8 Or rcl!тип >= 20 And rcl!тип <= 24 Then 'КЭС
If rcl!Ведомство = 1 Then v = 1 Else v = 4
Else 'ТЭЦ
If rcl!Ведомство = 1 Then v = 2 Else v = 3
End If
End If
ayears = split(Form_Редактирование_отчетных_данных.years, ",")
Workspaces(0).BeginTrans
Call setoptions
If z(rcl!MAIN) > 0 Then
sqlrep = "update [" & wtable & "] set ved=0 where numb1120=" & rcl!MAIN & ";"
DoCmd.RunSQL (sqlrep)
End If
For i = 0 To UBound(ayears)
sqlins = "insert into [" & wtable & "] (name,year,numb1120,numb1,oes,dep,er,obor,obl,ved,вед) values ("
sqlins = sqlins & """" & IIf(i = 0, rcl!Name, " ") & """," & ayears(i) & "," & NUMB1120 & "," & Replace(rcl!ordnumb, ",", ".") & "," & rcl!OES & "," & rcl!DEP & "," & rcl!ER & "," & rcl!тип & "," & rcl!OBL & "," & v & "," & rcl!Ведомство & ");"
DoCmd.RunSQL (sqlins)
Next i
Call resetoptions
With Forms("Редактирование_отчетных_данных")!stan.Form
.Requery
.RecordsetClone.FindFirst ("numb1120=" & NUMB1120)
.Bookmark = .RecordsetClone.Bookmark
End With
Workspaces(0).CommitTrans
endp:
End Sub
